name: M15 wick-rejection follow-through and failure screening batch

source_references.citation: Perry J. Kaufman, Trading Systems and Methods; frozen legacy backlog cites an unspecified edition at pages 111 and 157-158, while Wiley's 2019 sixth-edition catalog verifies only current bibliographic identity
source_references.supports: Bibliographic identity is publisher-verified, but the available local excerpt is book-derived and supplies no direct cost-aware M15 FX evidence; it motivates only the candle-geometry falsification territory.

research.evidence_summary: No inspected academic or cost-aware source establishes this rule. The frozen legacy backlog reports only book-level key-reversal context, so the batch is an original mechanical wick/close-location operationalization with a low prior.

feasibility.rationale: It uses supported FX M1 OHLC, causal M15 aggregation, signal-close fills, fixed ATR stops and same-day exits, but still requires V2 compatibility confirmation for isolated batch execution and result rows.

market.session: Weekday signals from completed M15 bars ending 09:00 through 12:45 Europe/London; every exit due no later than 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC aggregated into Europe/London wall-clock M15 intervals
data.minimum_history: Fixed V2 development data only, with 98 valid observed completed M15 closes through signal bar t; elapsed market gaps do not reset prior ATR state, and the signal bar itself must contain exactly 15 physically consecutive valid M1 candles
preprocessing: Treat M1 timestamp ts as [ts,ts+1 minute); a London M15 bar ending 09:00 contains [08:45,09:00)

Require exactly 15 consecutive unique M1 candles in signal bar t; valid OHLC is finite and positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), and high>=low; a duplicate is invalid before aggregation

Compute TR=max(high-low,abs(high-previous_observed_close),abs(low-previous_observed_close)), including elapsed daily/weekend gaps; seed Wilder ATR(96) with the arithmetic mean of the first 96 valid observed TRs, then ATR_i=(95*ATR_{i-1}+TR_i)/96; freeze ATR through t-1
Use IANA Europe/London rules and canonical UTC storage
dependencies: V2 resolved signal-time spread, commission and slippage
limitations: A wick and close location describe one completed candle but do not identify order flow or rejection causally
The legacy source is book-level context rather than direct cost-aware M15 FX evidence
Six correlated symbols and 96 correlated cells are not independent trials
No development result authorizes final-holdout access

hypothesis.behavior: A large directional wick with a close displaced toward the opposite end of an adequately large M15 candle may be followed either by rejection-direction continuation or by failure back toward the wick extreme.
hypothesis.mechanism: Follow-through could reflect exhaustion of aggressive liquidity taking at the wick extreme; failure could reflect a transient quote excursion or renewed pressure after the completed close.
works_when: The wick is large relative to its candle and the close is decisively displaced
One response sign persists across exact neighboring geometry thresholds and survives costs
fails_when: OHLC wick geometry is mostly bid-ask noise
Signal-close entry arrives after the rejection response
falsifiable_predictions: A declared response-mode center and at least three exact one-axis neighbors have positive net R
The cluster is positive in both UTC-midpoint development halves and at least three symbols
The cluster survives doubled costs and removal of the center's five best London dates

definitions.name: atr96_prior
definitions.formula: Wilder ATR(96) over valid observed M15 true ranges through t-1, using previous observed close across elapsed gaps
definitions.timing: Frozen before signal bar t; require finite and positive

definitions.name: bar_range
definitions.timing: Known at completed signal-bar close; require bar_range>0

definitions.name: rejection_direction
definitions.formula: -1 when upper_wick_ratio>=wick_ratio_min and close_location<=-close_location_min; +1 when lower_wick_ratio>=wick_ratio_min and close_location>=close_location_min; otherwise no signal
definitions.timing: The mutually exclusive close-location tests map the completed candle mechanically

definitions.name: trade_side
definitions.formula: rejection_direction for FOLLOW_REJECTION and -rejection_direction for FAILURE

entries.long_condition: eligible completed M15 t AND bar_range/atr96_prior>=range_atr_min AND ((rejection_direction=+1 AND response_mode=FOLLOW_REJECTION) OR (rejection_direction=-1 AND response_mode=FAILURE)) AND no open position for this symbol and cell
entries.short_condition: eligible completed M15 t AND bar_range/atr96_prior>=range_atr_min AND ((rejection_direction=-1 AND response_mode=FOLLOW_REJECTION) OR (rejection_direction=+1 AND response_mode=FAILURE)) AND no open position for this symbol and cell
entries.signal_time: Close of a London-aligned M15 interval ending 09:00 through 12:45 on a weekday when signal time plus holding_minutes is no later than 15:00
entries.execution_details: entry_price is the chart/bid close of M1 [signal_time-1 minute,signal_time), also the completed M15 close. Stop distance uses that chart price; V2 separately applies resolved or fixed-fallback spread, commission and slippage. The entry candle cannot trigger the new stop; management begins with the next M1.
entries.order_type: Market order at supported signal-close execution
restrictions: One open position per symbol per cell
No pyramiding or reset from an overlapping event
Require bar_range>0 and finite positive atr96_prior
Only one rejection direction can qualify because close_location_min is positive

exits.stop_loss: Long bid-chart stop = signal_close_bid-stop_atr_multiplier*atr96_prior; short bid-chart stop = signal_close_bid+stop_atr_multiplier*atr96_prior. Long triggers on bid, short on executable ask; adverse gap fills at V2's worse executable open with all costs.
exits.time_exit: Exit at the M1 close ending exactly signal_time plus holding_minutes; any invalid M1 in (entry_time,due_exit_time] fails the affected cell before exit; a valid due bar touching the stop resolves STOP_LOSS first
exits.maximum_holding: At most 120 minutes and never after 15:00 Europe/London
exits.end_of_session: No eligible entry may mature after 15:00 London; no pre-entry bar means no signal, while an in-position data defect fails only affected cells

risk.position_sizing: Each grid cell owns an isolated virtual portfolio. Within one cell, size same-timestamp symbol signals from that cell's common pre-entry equity snapshot so chart entry-to-stop risk equals 0.25% before costs; no equity, exposure, position or skip state crosses cells.
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Per cell: maximum six symbols and 1.50% aggregate initial stop risk; there is no global cap shared across the 96 isolated cell portfolios
risk.leverage: Use the lower of stop-risk size and V2 limits; skip if valid size cannot be represented
risk.concurrent_positions: Within each cell, one per symbol and six across its universe; all 96 cells have independent positions, equity, exposure, overlap decisions and data-failure state

experiment.baseline: range_atr_min=0.5, wick_ratio_min=0.4, close_location_min=0.25, response_mode=FOLLOW_REJECTION, holding_minutes=60, stop_atr_multiplier=1.0
robustness_tests: Report all 96 cells and every identifiable prior key-reversal, outside-bar, wick, no-wick and exhaustion-pattern trial
Report every symbol and halves split at the exact UTC midpoint of V2's fixed development interval; a close exactly at midpoint belongs to the first half
Multiply spread, commission and slippage individually by two for cost stress

For each mode center range=0.5/wick=0.4/close=0.25/hold=60/stop=1, rank dates by normal-cost pooled net R, tie by ascending date, remove its top five from the center and exact neighbors, and require retained normal- and doubled-cost net R to remain positive

For every center and neighbor, form a London-weekday daily net-R series from its first eligible post-warm-up date to development end, including zero on eligible no-trade dates; report a 95% percentile interval for mean daily net R from 10000 circular five-date block-bootstrap resamples with seed 2026009; the normal-cost center interval lower bound must exceed zero, while neighbor intervals are report-only
A mode advances only if its center and at least three exact one-axis neighbors range=1.0, wick=0.6, close=0.5, hold=30, hold=120 and stop=2 pass all gates
costs: Use V2 timestamp-resolved or frozen fixed-fallback spread plus commission and slippage at every fill
Doubled stress multiplies each cost component by two
No swap because all positions close before 15:00 London
benchmarks: Opposite response mode on identical wick events
experiment.multiple_testing: Count all 96 selectable cells and all identifiable prior I-12/I-40, wick, no-wick, outside-bar and key-reversal trials. If the historical ledger is incomplete, label multiplicity incomplete and prohibit a confirmatory claim. No best-cell rescue is allowed.
rejection_criteria: Reject a mode unless its center and at least three exact neighbors are positive after normal and doubled costs
Reject if the cluster is non-positive in either UTC-midpoint development half
Reject if fewer than three symbols have positive center net R in each half
Reject if the center has fewer than 300 pooled trades
Reject if five-date removal makes the center or required neighbors non-positive under either normal or doubled costs
Reject if the normal-cost center's seeded circular-block-bootstrap 95% interval for mean London-weekday daily net R does not lie wholly above zero
Reject affected cells on any invalid M1 in (entry_time,due_exit_time] and prohibit promotion if a required cluster contains a failed cell
Never access the final holdout without explicit authorization for a separately frozen promoted version

pseudocode: Build valid London-aligned M15 bars causally from interval-start M1.
At each eligible completed M15 close compute range, upper/lower wick ratios and close location.
Require the range threshold and map the mutually exclusive upper/lower rejection event to follow-rejection or failure side.
Enter at signal close when that cell is flat and freeze its bid-chart ATR stop.
Starting next M1 process adverse gap/intrabar stop before due time exit; fail only affected cells on data defects.
Publish all 96 cells, centers, exact neighbors, costs, partitions, bootstrap and multiplicity fields.
required_libraries: existing V2 candle, timezone, cost, fill and R-accounting components
edge_cases: duplicate M1 is invalid before aggregation
exact wick and close thresholds qualify
elapsed gaps count in ATR but cannot make an incomplete signal bar
upper and lower events are mutually exclusive
stop and time exit collide as stop first
gap stop uses worse executable open
implementation.computational_requirements: One causal pass per symbol; cache shared M15, ATR and geometry features while preserving independent position state for 96 cells.
known_backtester_gaps: Queue submission waits for V2's M15/fill/cell-state compatibility response and a batch-specific confirmation that 96 isolated cells and required result rows are supported
